description: Ask the project's owner a question when the spec is unclear. This blocks the criterion (category spec_unclear) and shows the question on the board, with your suggested options if you give any. Keep working on other ready criteria while you wait, then call vibemap_get_answers to collect the reply; once a person answers, the criterion is unblocked automatically.

options.description: Optional suggested answers the person can pick from (1-10)

reason.description: Optional context for the block; defaults to the question

name: vibemap_ask_user
